name: HelioNet-Transformer-OMNI2
description: Trained 2-layer Transformer space weather forecasting model on NASA OMNI2 hourly archive.
notes: The flare head has no training data in the NASA OMNI2 hourly archive and is not trained (marked as Not available).

proton.note: OMNI2 low_res archive discontinued energetic proton flux ingestion after 2020.

proton_tss_winner.model: N/A (No test events recorded in OMNI2)

comparison_summary.scientific_takeaway: On the geomagnetic storm head, logistic_regression achieved highest TSS (0.489). For continuous Dst regression, lightgbm achieved lowest RMSE (21.64 nT). Both LightGBM and the Transformer strongly outperform persistence and linear baselines.
